title: The Logic That Learned to Sleep

features.name: circuit-that-loops-and-rests
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board endlessly tracing its own path, then pausing, then tracing again. The pause is not a failure; it is where logic dreams.

features.name: proof-that-curves-back
features.desc-on-touch: Mathematical equations arranged in a spiral, each step following logically from the last, until the spiral returns to its own beginning. Here logic and dream are indistinguishable.

features.name: counter-that-forgets-its-last-number
features.desc-on-touch: A counting mechanism that increments perfectly until it reaches sleep, then forgets the number and starts counting again. Neither state is wrong.

features.name: decision-tree-growing-inward
features.desc-on-touch: Branches of logic splitting and re-joining, then retreating back into the trunk where they rest as possibility, not as choice.

features.name: contradiction-made-comfortable
features.desc-on-touch: Two statements that cannot both be true, sleeping side by side. The contradiction doesn't trouble them; here, incompatibility is a form of rest.

features.name: dreaming-algorithm
features.desc-on-touch: An ordered sequence that forgets its order and follows association instead. The result is weirder and more true than the original logic.

inscription: here logic learned that it too must rest; dreaming is not a failure of thought but a completion of it; repetition becomes a form of truth
